evaluation.expanding_refit_reason: No candidate passed the preceding economic, uncertainty, stability, and cost gates.

principal_findings: Predictive ranking was modest and did not become a stable economic exit policy.
Some LONG variants increased median profit capture but reduced net expectancy versus their frozen baseline.
SHORT variants did not consistently improve either capture or net expectancy.
Volume ratio above 4 and directional RSI extension had the strongest descriptive giveback associations, but were not validated as exit rules.
No-new-extreme, velocity decay, taker-flow decay, structure, and BTC context were weak or inconsistent in the preregistered horizon.
